your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Ending turn with $87 cash buffer and Green at 2-2-3 houses while p2 sits on Water Works right before my Green monopoly.
Rolling for doubles to maximize my chances of staying in jail and avoiding p3's developed Orange monopoly right outside jail, while preserving my $1,087 cash to build up Green into hotels.

In this engine, failing a jail roll ends the turn immediately without a post-roll build phase. Since I must cross p3's Orange monopoly eventually anyway, paying $50 to leave jail now lets me cross Orange while it is still at 2-2-3 houses ($200/$200/$600) and then immediately invest my ~$1,037 cash into building up my Green monopoly during my post-roll phase before p3 leaves jail.

Building 1 house each on Pacific and North Carolina ($400 total) to bring the Green monopoly to 3-3-3 houses ($900/$900/$1,000 rent), leaving $837 cash. Will evaluate adding a 4th house on the next step.

At Community Chest (pos 17), I am past St. James and cannot roll a 1 to hit Tennessee, leaving only a 1/36 chance (snake eyes) to hit New York Avenue. Building 1 house each on North Carolina and Pennsylvania ($400 total) pushes Green to 3-4-4 houses ($900/$1,100/$1,200 rent) while keeping $437 cash buffer.
Ending turn with Green at 3-4-4 houses ($900/$1,100/$1,200 rent) and $437 cash buffer while positioned at Community Chest (pos 17), past almost all of p3's Orange monopoly.
Keeping $637 cash as a buffer to cross p3's Orange monopoly ($550-$600 rent) without being forced to sell Green houses at half price. Green remains at 3-4-4 houses ($900/$1,100/$1,200 rent).

Keeping $613 cash buffer on Virginia Avenue so I can absorb a potential $550-$600 rent on p3's Orange monopoly without liquidating Green houses. Meanwhile, p3 is on Indiana Avenue (8-11 spaces from Green) with a total liquidation value around $1,098, meaning a hit on North Carolina ($1,100) or Pennsylvania ($1,200) will bankrupt p3 outright.

Building a 4th house on Pacific Avenue for $200 now that I am past p3's Orange monopoly and p3 is on Water Works right in front of Green. This brings Green to 4-4-4 houses ($1,100/$1,100/$1,200 rent) and unlocks hotel building on the next step.

p3's total liquidation value is $1,414 ($49 cash + $675 from selling 9 Orange houses and 2 Brown hotels + $690 from mortgaging 8 unmortgaged properties). Building a hotel on Pennsylvania Avenue for $200 raises its rent from $1,200 to $1,400 while leaving me $213 cash to easily cover Park Place ($35) and Luxury Tax ($100) before passing GO.
